title: Figure 1. Intra-Universe Wormhole as a Hyperspace Shortcut Through Conventional Space
description: Perspective grid diagram of a folded sheet of "Conventional Space" with a green funnel-shaped "Wormhole" connecting a blue spot labeled "Earth" to a yellow spot labeled "Sirius" through "Hyperspace". Annotation reads "Distance from Earth to Sirius: 54 Trillion Miles (90 Trillion Kilometers)". Text below discusses traversable wormholes and interstellar propulsion concepts.
